title: Edilgen Cati (Passive Voice)
description_tr: Edilgen cati (Passive Voice), eylemi yapanin degil, eylemden etkilenenin on plana cikartildigi yapidir. Ozellikle tip ve hastane baglaminida cok kullanilir: 'Hasta ameliyat edildi', 'Ilac reçete edildi' gibi. Sinavlarda active cumlyi passive'e cevirme veya dogru 'be + V3' formunu secme sorulur.
formula: Object + be (zamana gore) + V3 (past participle) + by + subject (istege bagli)
turkish_logic: Turkce'de edilgen cati '-il, -in, -ul, -un' ekleriyle yapilir: 'Kapi acildi' (The door was opened). Ingilizce'de ise 'be + V3' formulu kullanilir. 'be' fiili zamana gore degisir (is, was, has been, will be vb.), V3 ise fiilin ucuncu hali olarak sabit kalir.
key_rules: Present Simple Passive: am/is/are + V3. 'Blood tests are done every morning.' (Kan testleri her sabah yapilir.)
Past Simple Passive: was/were + V3. 'The patient was examined by Dr. Smith.' (Hasta Dr. Smith tarafindan muayene edildi.)
Present Perfect Passive: has/have + been + V3. 'The surgery has been completed successfully.' (Ameliyat basariyla tamamlandi.)
Future Simple Passive: will + be + V3. 'The results will be announced tomorrow.' (Sonuclar yarin aciklanacak.)
Present Continuous Passive: am/is/are + being + V3. 'The patient is being treated now.' (Hasta su anda tedavi ediliyor.)
Past Continuous Passive: was/were + being + V3. 'The wound was being cleaned when the doctor arrived.' (Doktor geldiginde yara temizleniyordu.)
Modal Passive: modal + be + V3. 'The medicine must be taken twice a day.' (Ilac gunde iki kez alinmalidir.)
'By + agent' sadece yapanin kim oldugu onemliyse eklenir. 'The hospital was built in 1990.' (Kim yaptigi onemli degil.)

examples.en: The patient was transferred to the ICU.
examples.why: Hastanin kim tarafindan transfer edildigi onemli degil, onemli olan hastanin durumu. Past Simple Passive: was + V3 (transferred).

examples.en: New vaccines are being developed by several companies.
examples.tr: Yeni asilar birkac sirket tarafindan gelistiriliyor.
examples.why: Su anda devam eden bir eylem, nesne on planda. Present Continuous Passive: are + being + V3 (developed).

examples.en: The prescription has been sent to the pharmacy.
examples.why: Yakin gecmiste tamamlanan ve simdi etkisi olan eylem. Present Perfect Passive: has + been + V3 (sent).

examples.en: The blood pressure must be measured before the operation.
examples.why: Zorunluluk bildiren modal + passive. Modal Passive: must + be + V3 (measured).

examples.en: The wound was being stitched when the power went out.
examples.why: Gecmiste devam eden bir eylem baska bir eylemle kesilmis. Past Continuous Passive: was + being + V3 (stitched).

examples.en: All visitors will be screened at the entrance.
examples.why: Gelecekte yapilacak bir eylem, nesne on planda. Future Simple Passive: will + be + V3 (screened).

tips: Passive formul: 'be + V3' — bu ikiliyi gordugunde passive oldugunu anla. 'be' fiili zamana gore degisir.
Active'den Passive'e cevirirken: 1) Nesneyi basa al, 2) 'be' fiilini zamana gore sec, 3) Fiili V3 yap, 4) Gerekirse 'by + ozne' ekle.
'By' her zaman gerekmez! Yapan kisi belli degilse veya onemli degilse 'by' kullanma. 'The door was opened.' yeterli.
Intransitive fiiller (die, arrive, happen, sleep) passive yapilamaz! 'He was died' YANLIS.
Sinav taktigi: Seceneklerde 'was + V3', 'is being + V3', 'has been + V3' gibi yapilar goruyorsan passive sorusu. Cumledeki zamani belirle, dogru 'be' formunu sec.
'Get + V3' konusma dilinde passive yerine kullanilir: 'He got injured' = 'He was injured'. Sinavda 'be + V3' tercih et.
Tip metinlerinde passive cok cikar cunku odak hastanin/tedavinin uzerindedir, yapan kisi (doktor/hemsire) genelde belirtilmez.
